feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: How to think about the midterms — and the political moment the country is in
entry.summary: Polls show Democrats with an advantage in the midterm election but there are potential limitations and results may take a while to roll in.

entry.title: The midterms will test the nation's political direction and confidence
entry.summary: At least some portion of the nation is likely to have its political confidence — and perhaps even its sense of security — tested in the days and weeks ahead. That test could also continue for some time to come.

entry.title: New York City Marathon: Sweden's Almgren and Kenya's Chepkirui win as 60,000 take part
entry.summary: Andreas Almgren of Sweden won the men's race of the New York City Marathon in his debut in the event while Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya won the women's race on Sunday for the second time.

entry.title: Living with high prices in Virginia's 1st Congressional District
entry.summary: High prices are straining budgets for both a small business owner and a single mom in a rural part of Va.'s 1st Congressional district. They explain how they're handling the economic stress of these times.

entry.title: Here's how to watch election night as the polls close, hour-by-hour
entry.summary: As polls close on election night, here's a look at what to expect each hour and which midterm races are key to deciding control of Congress.

entry.title: 'Grasping at straws': Judge dismisses Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein letter
entry.summary: Saying the president was "grasping at straws," a federal judge on Saturday threw out Donald Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a story reporting on his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

entry.title: Devastating storms continue to hit Southwest 'Four Corners' region
entry.summary: Communities in the Southwest are bracing for more flooding this weekend. This follows weeks of devastating storms that have pummeled parts of the region.

entry.title: Meet Mia Moroz, the Culver City high school senior fighting for teen voting rights
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Simon talks to Mia Moroz, a high school senior and head of a group pushing to get 16 and 17 year-olds the vote in Culver City, Calif.

entry.title: Swept away: The artisan magic of Meckley Brooms in Pennsylvania
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Simon talks to Briana Meckley, owner of Meckley Brooms in Lopez, Pennsylvania, about her business' surge in broom orders for Halloween.

entry.title: Plans for a data center threaten scenic wilderness and dark skies in West Virginia
entry.summary: Residents are fighting back against plans for a project that would span thousands of acres near the Monongahela National Forest and popular outdoor recreation, ski areas and dark sky sites.
